scoring_justification: Recompute water flux, salt rejection, and PMF barriers from submitted CSVs; compare against paper-reported reference values with tolerances and trend checks.

outputs.description: Water flux across five functionalized graphene membranes at pressures from 50 to 530 MPa. Reference comparison includes quantitative tolerances and checks for linear flux-pressure trend and ordering (N-graphene highest).
Salt rejection (0-1) for each membrane at several pressures. Reference comparison checks near-perfect rejection for NOH-graphene and tolerance for others.
PMF profiles for water, Na+, and Cl- through each pore. Reference comparison checks barrier heights and relative ordering (lowest barrier for N-graphene, high for ions).

output_contract.notes: The checker compares submitted CSV data against reference values with tolerances appropriate for toolchain differences. It also verifies structural trends: linear increase of flux with pressure, highest flux for N-graphene, salt rejection near 1 for NOH-graphene, and PMF barrier ordering consistent with the paper.

steps.description: Validate water flux data: N-graphene flux at 130 MPa ~66 ns^{-1}, highest flux among membranes, linear increase with pressure.
Validate salt rejection: NOH-graphene shows near-complete rejection (≥0.99), other membranes have reasonable rejection.
Validate PMF barriers: water barriers 2.0-3.5 kcal/mol with correct ordering, Na+ barriers ≥3.0 kcal/mol and N-graphene lowest, Cl- barriers ≥15 kcal/mol.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for water flux, salt rejection, and PMF barriers.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 2(c), Fig. 3, Fig. 5, and corresponding text (e.g., water flux ~66 ns^{-1} at 130 MPa, NOH rejection 100%, PMF barrier ranges).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published numerical claims of the source paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are directly traceable to the paper's reported results, ensuring the hidden gold is authentic and consistent with the reproduction target.
